escalation_required: any agent holding more than max_concurrent_tokens active tokens
any agent accepting a new task without revoking the previous token

token_concurrency_rules.principle: One active token per agent by default; queued when busy.

token_states.active: Token emitted and not yet completed or revoked.
token_states.queued: Task waiting because agent is at max_concurrent_tokens.
token_states.orphan: Token active beyond orphan_token_timeout_minutes without completion report.

guardian_actions.emit: Issue token if agent is below max_concurrent_tokens.
guardian_actions.enqueue: Add request to agent queue if at limit and queue_policy is enqueue.
guardian_actions.reject: Reject request if at limit and queue_policy is reject.
guardian_actions.revoke_orphan: Automatically revoke orphan tokens and notify the agent.
guardian_actions.promote_next: After token revocation, emit token to the next queued task.

inter_agent_availability_check.protocol: Before sending an inter-agent request, query the Guardian for the target agent's availability.
inter_agent_availability_check.response_available: Target is below max_concurrent_tokens; proceed with request.
inter_agent_availability_check.response_busy: Target is at limit; enqueue request or escalate to Guardian.

knowledge_graph.benefit: Reduces token consumption by 70-80% for architecture queries
